aboutSubheading: Quality construction services for Melbourne's bayside communities
aboutText: With over 15 years of building experience across Melbourne's south-east, Donnellan Constructions has been proudly serving Chelsea and the surrounding bayside suburbs including Mentone, Parkdale, and Mordialloc. Our skilled team delivers quality craftsmanship on every project, from new home builds and extensions to complete renovations and outdoor living spaces.
fullWidthImageAlt: Beautifully constructed modern home by Donnellan Constructions
servicesSubheading: Comprehensive building solutions tailored to your needs
servicesText: From new home builds to renovations and extensions, we offer a full range of construction services across Chelsea, Mentone, Parkdale, and the broader Melbourne bayside area.

testimonialsSubheading: Hear from homeowners across Melbourne's bayside who trust Donnellan Constructions

testimonials.text: Donnellan Constructions did a brilliant job on our home extension in Chelsea. Brad and his team were professional from start to finish, kept the site tidy, and finished ahead of schedule. Couldn't be happier with the result.
testimonials.name: Brad Mitchell

testimonials.text: We had our kitchen and living area completely renovated and the transformation is incredible. The team understood exactly what we wanted and the craftsmanship is top-notch. Highly recommend to anyone in the bayside area.
testimonials.name: Sarah Nguyen

testimonials.text: From the initial quote through to the final walkthrough, the crew were honest, reliable, and delivered exceptional quality. Our new deck and outdoor entertaining area has become the heart of our home.
testimonials.name: Tom Crawford
